components.note: Sources conflict on whether this was an additional disc or content on the normal game disc; no separate bonus-disc claim is made.

notes: GameFAQs and VGCollect independently tie SLUS-21489 and UPC 722674100687 to the 2007-09-10 North American/USA product.
Redump records the USA Original disc as English with serial SLUS 21489.

VGCollect transcribes a bonus-feature statement and also lists additional disc item PDSS-024565, while a GameFAQs FAQ says ROOTS episode 6 is on the normal Vol.3 game disc; component delivery remains unresolved.

releases.releaseTitle: .hack//G.U. Vol.3 歩くような速さで
notes: Sony's PlayStation 2 the Best announcement confirms the title, publisher and 2009-11-26 release date.
GameFAQs, Suruga-ya and Retroplace independently associate SLPS-73267 and JAN/EAN 4582224493135 with this .hack budget release.
Two unrelated retailer records also assign SLPS-73267 to an SNK NEOGEO Online Collection Complete Box lower-volume product; the conflict is preserved rather than ignored.
Packaging and software languages remain unresolved.
LaunchBox and MobyGames maintain separate Canada cover groupings for the PS2 release.
No direct retained source tied a Canadian barcode, serial, printed languages or release date to this packaging; USA identifiers were not copied into this variant.
A direct eBay listing describes the outer set as a promotional item marked NOT FOR SALE and enumerates Vols.1-3 plus a .hack//G.U. Trilogy anime DVD.
That listing calls the set a five-disc box set but the retained description does not unambiguously identify the fifth disc; no extra component is invented.
Yahoo! Auctions completed-search results provide discovery context for similarly titled Complete Works/Vol.1-3 sets but are not used alone as confirmation.

conflicts.note: Multiple .hack-specific sources independently tie SLPS-73267 to the Vol.3 PlayStation 2 the Best release, while two unrelated retailer records assign the same model code to an SNK NEOGEO Online Collection Complete Box product. The .hack mapping is retained as confirmed from the stronger cross-source set, and the unrelated-code collision/error is preserved for audit.

VGCollect records additional disc item PDSS-024565 and transcribes the episode-6 bonus feature, while a GameFAQs FAQ says episode 6 is on the normal Vol.3 game disc. No separate bonus-disc component is confirmed.
The existing catalog title is a normalized style; external release sources use .hack//G.U. styling. No identity conflict was found.

The direct listing calls the promotional set a five-disc box set but the retained textual enumeration clearly names Vol.1, Vol.2, Vol.3 and a .hack//G.U. Trilogy anime DVD without unambiguously identifying the fifth disc. No fifth component is invented.
